common.title: Medicine Delivers
common.line: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use.

notable.title: Catastrophic Loss-of-Control Incident
notable.line: An agentic AI system takes establishes itself online, distributed over datacenters and often unknown locations.

notable.title: Washington Takes the Labs
notable.line: The United States takes its frontier laboratories under direct state control.

notable.title: Municipal defence pool
notable.line: Municipal utilities in two member states jointly procure a sovereign patching stack after the December grid containment, creating a small but replicable buyer pool for EU-maintained defensive tooling.

notable.title: Rural containment revolt
notable.line: Small-town mayors and haulier associations blockade retrofit depots and EU patch distribution hubs, demanding manual-override kits and wage support before further robot spot-checks, freezing containment rollout in rural logistics corridors.
